The [[Zaishen Vanquish]] [[signpost]] is an [[NPC]] that offers a different daily [[Zaishen Challenge Quest]] for gold, title points, experience, and [[Copper Zaishen Coin]]s. Rewards for these quests can be claimed from [[Zehnchu]] at the [[Great Temple of Balthazar]] or [[Embark Beach]].

== Locations ==
* [[The Battle Isles]]
** {{NPC location|Embark Beach}}

== Quests ==
* The current available quest, as of {{#time: H:i, j F Y }} (UTC), is [[ {{Cycle|ZVanquish}} (Zaishen vanquish)]].

The available quest changes daily based on a recurring cycle. For a quick overview of upcoming quests, see [[Zaishen Challenge Quest]]. For information about the current or previous cycles, see the [[Zaishen Vanquish/cycles|cycles subpage]]. For a full list of quests and rewards, see the [[Zaishen_Challenge_Quest/Vanquish|rewards table]] or the [[:Category:Zaishen Vanquish quests|category listing]].

:<small>'''Note:''' If the UTC time shown above does not match the UTC clock time at the top of the page, you can [{{fullurl:{{FULLPAGENAME}}|action=purge}} purge this page] to update the quest display.</small>

== Dialogue ==
: "''This is the signpost where Zaishen Vanquish quests are posted.''"

; If the daily quest has already been taken:
: "''There are no more quests available here today, but other signs may have more postings from the Zaishen.''"

; If the character already has three Zaishen Vanquish quests active:
: "''There are still threats that remain. Return when you have slain all of the foes that await you at your destination.''"

; When asked about a quest:
: "''There are still threats that remain. Return when you have slain all of the foes that await you at your destination.''"

== Notes ==
{{anomaly|When a character reaches the limit of 3 active Zaishen Vanquish quests, this signpost responds with the standard "quest active" dialogue ("There are still threats that remain..."). Other Zaishen signposts typically display a specific message explaining the 3-quest limit.}}
{{bug|A character may be unable to accept a quest if they do not change [[district]]s, [[zone]], or [[Log Out|log out]] between turning in the reward and the quest's next appearance in the cycle.}}
* [[Vanquisher|Vanquishing]] an [[explorable area]] in [[Vabbi]] awards [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer promotion points]]. However, the corresponding Zaishen Vanquish quest awards [[Sunspear rank|Sunspear promotion points]].

== Trivia ==
* With 136 total areas to vanquish, a full cycle takes approximately four and a half months.
* Vanquishing every area in the cycle will complete the Vanquisher titles for each campaign: 54 areas for [[Prophecies]], 34 for [[Nightfall]], and 33 for [[Factions]]. The remaining 15 areas contribute 225 points toward the [[Master of the North]] title.
* Zaishen Vanquish quests were added in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20110303|March 3, 2011 update]].
